newsitem.title: UK: Fergie to appear in TV ad for cranberry juice.
newsitem.headline: Fergie to appear in TV ad for cranberry juice.

text.p: Britain's Duchess of York, Sarah Ferguson, who has been struggling to wipe out her debts, is being paid 500,000 pounds ($838,000) to make a television advertisement for cranberry juice, according to a report published on Monday.

The flamboyant, red-haired duchess known as Fergie, whose 10-year marriage to Prince Andrew ended in divorce last April, will start filming the ad for Ocean Spray cranberry juice in Los Angeles on Monday, the Mirror newspaper said.
The ad, which will be shown only in the United States, will show Fergie speaking directly to the camera, the newspaper said.

The ad marks the first time a British royal is to endorse a product on television, but it is not an advertising debut for the duchess who in early November appeared in a magazine advert for an Olympus digital camera.
That ad was to be carried in magazines appearing in continental Europe, but not in Britain in a bid to save the duchess' former royal in-laws from embarrassment. ($ = 0.596 British Pounds)
